newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - July 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - July 2.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- President Kim Young-sam on Tuesday designated former National Assembly Speaker Lee Man-sup as acting chairman of the ruling New Korea Party, filling the post until the party's presidential candidate is elected in a national convention on July 21.

- South Korea Foreign Minister Yoo Chong-ha met in his Japanese counterpart Ikeda Yukihiko in Hong Kong and asked Japan to set free 19 Korean sailors from the two ships Tokyo seized last month after insisting the ships had entered Japanese waters.
- Korea's exports his a record-high in June, resulting in a trade surplus for the first time in 30 months.
- North Korea, South Korea and U.S. announced in a joint statement following a meeting at a New York that four-way talks would be held on August 5.
- The Defense Ministry said, a missile North Korea recently test-fired was not a cruise missile but an unsophisticated anti-ship missile.
